_comment: Country-specific display configuration for Mongolia. Surfaces provenance strings and source refs to the dashboard so country-specific text does not need to live in TypeScript. A second country should drop a `{country}-country-config.json` alongside its targets file with the same shape.

docProvenance.NDC: Mongolia NDC 3.0 under the UNFCCC Paris Agreement, submitted September 2025 (English official submission)
docProvenance.NITIPA: National targets for implementation of the Paris Agreement, Government of Mongolia Resolution No. 91 (10 September 2025); Mongolian original on legalinfo.mn. English target text is a translation supplied with the partner-curated targets spreadsheet (August 2026).
docProvenance.NAP: Mongolia NAP, completed 2024 (per BTR1 Section 3.9.1.8, Table III.8)
docProvenance.SECTORAL: Vision 2050 Long-term Development Policy, Parliament Resolution 52, May 2020
docProvenance.FSS: Food Supply and Security Measures, Mongolia Parliament Resolution 36 (17 June 2022)
docProvenance.NRVTS: Mongolia National Report on Voluntary Target Setting to Achieve Land Degradation Neutrality (UNCCD LDN Target Setting Programme; Mongolia LDN TSP Country Report)
docProvenance.ILDN: Investing in Land Degradation Neutrality, Mongolia (UNCCD LDN Target Setting Programme)

_documentTypesComment: Mongolia's document-type registry. These entries MUST reproduce the labels and colors that were previously hardcoded in src/lib/utils.ts (DOC_LABELS/DOC_COLORS/DOC_MEDIUM_LABELS/DOC_FULL_LABELS) verbatim so Mongolia's dashboard display is unchanged after the open-PolicyDocumentType migration. BTR and OTHER are reserved tokens with universal fallbacks in src/lib/utils.ts but are declared here explicitly for clarity. Order: anchor (Vision 2050) first; BTR last among country-declared docs (OTHER catch-all comes after).
_documentMetaComment: Reference metadata (docKind / published / author / url / objective) for the doc-focus panel; urls verified HTTP 200 on 2026-06-30 (NDC 3.0 and NITIPA urls verified 2026-08-09) by reading the document's cover/front matter. Sources: Vision 2050 on cabinet.gov.mn; NDC 3.0 (2025), NAP and BTR1 on unfccc.int; NBSAP (the 2015 National Biodiversity Program, CBD; English is an unofficial translation) on cbd.int; FSS = State Great Hural Resolution 36 of 17 Jun 2022 and NITIPA = Government Resolution No. 91 of 10 Sep 2025 on legalinfo.mn (both Mongolian only, no official English version); NRVTS and ILDN on unccd.int. Objectives for Vision 2050 and the NDC are verbatim from those documents. ILDN's cover carries no date (UNCCD repository folder dated Feb 2019) so its published is omitted. BER (internal expenditure review) and OTHER (catch-all) have no public single-document source, so no metadata is set. The 27 NDC targets analysed before August 2026 mixed NDC 3.0 content with Resolution 91 content; the corpus now separates them (NDC vs NITIPA).
_docClassComment: Machine-readable document classification (docClass) and national-hierarchy level (docTier) consumed by src/lib/doc-taxonomy. Added Aug 2026 to bring Mongolia to parity with Panama (same focal-group rationale: undifferentiated documents lead readers to misread relationships). THE VOCABULARY IS PROJECT-DEFINED (see DOC_CLASSES in src/lib/doc-taxonomy); EACH ASSIGNMENT TRACES TO THE DOCUMENT'S OWN SELF-DESCRIPTION recorded in docKind / fullLabel below, never its subject matter: SECTORAL is Vision 2050, the whole-of-government Long-term Development Policy every other instrument answers to and this tool's declared anchorDocType (strategic_plan; tier 1 - it is not term-scoped like Panama's PEG, noted as a deliberate deviation from the class's term-plan wording). NDC is a contribution declared to the UNFCCC (commitment, tier 2); NRVTS declares voluntary national LDN targets to the UNCCD, the same act as an NDC (commitment, tier 2). NITIPA is a government resolution operationalising the Paris Agreement domestically (roadmap, tier 3). NBSAP calls itself a Strategy and Action Plan for one theme (sector_strategy, tier 3); NAP and FSS are theme-scoped national plans / sectoral measures (sector_plan, tier 3). BER is an expenditure review, not a policy instrument (reporting, tier 5). ILDN (a country profile / investment case) and OTHER map to no class and are deliberately left unassigned; BTR is not listed because reporting / tier 5 comes from the reserved-token defaults in doc-taxonomy. NOT YET REVIEWED BY THE COUNTRY OFFICE - confirm before this ships.
